title: Chapter 6799: Depends On Your Luck

Chapter 6799: Depends On Your Luck

Chapter 6799: Depends On Your Luck

After leaving Epoch Dawn, Li Qiye asked: “What do you two want to do?”

“I wish to follow you, Young Noble.” The middle-aged man bowed.

“Don’t let the minor details overshadow the big picture. I saved you so that your sword dao can be free, it will exist between heaven and earth, within every flower and insect. Travel where your heart takes you, observe the world and comprehend life. You mustn’t shackle yourself because I saved you, that would be antithetical to your dao.” Li Qiye elaborated.

The middle-aged man broke out in cold sweat and prostrated: “I will not forget your teachings.”

“Don’t let this sword dao down.” Li Qiye patted the sword and it hymned in response.

“I don’t know how to repay you, Young Noble.” He said.

“Learn the sword dao with your heart as the focus, never fall into depravity, that’s how you can repay me.” Li Qiye said.

“I will never waver.” He bowed and said decisively.

“Go.” Li Qiye waved.

“I don’t know if I will meet you again, Young Noble. Please allow me to show respect.” He said before performing a full kowtow rite.

Afterward, he turned and left with a new focus.

“And you?” Li Qiye asked the woman.

“Where are you going?” She asked with a cold glare.

“Visiting Stygian.” Li Qiye said.

“To deal with Devouring Alliance?” Her brows furrowed.

“Close enough, and to find a world’s heart while I’m there.” Li Qiye said.

“That disappeared long ago, even Mang couldn’t find it.” She said.

“I’m different.” Li Qiye smiled.

“Then you have to find the Gate of Wisdom first. Rumor has it Mang and his direct disciple, Guangmai, found it back then.” She said.

“Not all rumors are correct.” He said.

“Guangmai became a primordial immortal afterward, so he must have found a natural primordial legacy. Trinity, with his sharp senses like a hound, also rushed there.” She said.

“There wasn’t any trace.” Li Qiye shook his head.

“I suspect he came for the heart. Unfortunately, his luck ran out and he had no support in Heavenrealm. That’s why he left no trace or information.” She said.

“I could look for Guangmai, but that heart isn’t with him.” He said.

“How are you so sure?” She asked: “Where did you get your information?”

“Origination Enterprise.” Li Qiye said.

“You saw Origination? He must be close to death.” She said.

“The world thinks so but he’ll outlast anyone. His root is the past but it can also reach the future.” He said.

“Origination is a flower hidden in the mist, obscured in the past and reflected in the present, not entirely trustworthy.” She said.

“That depends on who he’s talking to. Different conversations and different reflections from the past.” He said.

“Just say it straight, you got him to appear, right?” She became angry.

“Close enough.” He smiled.

“Time to repay the debt?” She asked.

“So Qi Zhen already told you.” He said.

“There’s a place in Stygian.” She paused for a moment before speaking: “Tinyleaf City, I wonder if it is still there.”

“What is special about this place?” He asked.

“Immortal Emperor Fei’s resting place.” She said.

“I see.” He had a solemn expression.

“Deepsouth Divine Emperor became a fallen one in Stygian. Immortal Emperor Fei pursued and the two fought to the bitter end. However, Immortal Emperor Fei didn’t die in battle and fell into Golden Lamp Everlasting Ground, eventually passing away in Tinyleaf. Few are aware of this, even Guardian Alliance thought both died in battle.” She said.

Li Qiye let out a sigh after hearing the story.

Immortal Emperor Fei was once the most brilliant among his peers, the founder of Soaring Immortal Sect.

He ascended to the thirteen continents and was highly valued by Deepsouth Divine Emperor. Keep in mind that the relationship between the races was terrible.

Deepsouth had twelve palaces and was the lord of the diviners while Fei was a lowly human. Nevertheless, he was protective of Fei and even gave him his daughter’s hand in marriage. She was the fairest of their race.

Thus, their trust and bond couldn’t be overstated. The two eventually collaborated to initiate the third expedition, bringing numerous emperors and ancient gods to the Heavenrealm. Who would have thought this would end with the duo becoming mortal enemies?

“There’s a high probability that the gate caused Deepsouth Divine Emperor’s fall. Only Immortal Emperor Fei knew the truth, but this is still a better clue than Guangmai. This cultivator did not appear to help Mang during his fight with Immortal Emperor Min Ren. Maybe he died long ago.” She said.

“We’ll see if this Tinyleaf City is still there.” Li Qiye said.

“Even if it is, I’m not sure if you will be able to find the answer. The emperor never spoke on this matter, I just know the gate was involved somehow. It depends on how lucky you are.” She said.

“Understandable.” Li Qiye said.

Deepsouth became Guardian Alliance’s main target after his fall. After all, it nearly caused a chasm in the alliance.

Nevertheless, Immortal Emperor Fei never said a bad thing about his father-in-law. He chose action instead, fighting to the death in Stygian. The secret was buried with them.

“Good luck.” She shrugged.

“You’re not coming?” Li Qiye smiled.

“Why should I?” She glared at him.

“True.” He rubbed his nose.
